title: Intention
description: An intention file describing a customer's observable state — AI Maturity Model scores, industry, cloud posture, regulatory context, production AI inventory, team shape, and engagement goals. Serves as the sole input to resolution in the intention-driven delivery system. See design.md §Data Models — Model 1.

schemaVersion.description: Intention schema major version. Only '1' is currently supported.

industry.description: Industry vertical. Drives lens activation and default regulatory posture.

regulated.description: Whether the customer operates under regulatory constraints. May be inferred from industry when unset.

aim.description: AI Maturity Model scores per perspective, each on an integer tier 1..5.

goals.description: Engagement goals. At least one goal is required; duplicates are rejected.

workload.description: Workload context for build/prototype engagements. Captures the application type, maturity level, and primary description to drive ai-native-app-builder routing.

appType.description: Application archetype that drives scaffolding, AWS service selection, and layer activation.

appLevel.description: Workload maturity. PoC = 2-week answer to one technical question. MVP = pilot with real users on real data. Production = external/full-volume traffic.

primaryDescription.description: One-line description of the primary workload. Hint for downstream skills, not a substitute for discovery.

production.description: Production AI inventory and team sizing.

notes.description: Free-form notes from the FDE. Capped at 4000 characters.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last update to this intention.

aimTier.description: AIM tier value in the closed interval [1, 5].
